Hi Logan / Marissa,

Thanks for the pre-call today. Per our discussion, Ariadne is ready to kick off the sealed-bundle acceptance flow for our on-prem appliance. We need to validate the delivery, signer rotation process, and a short operator activation checklist before we can schedule the install window.

High-level asks from our side:
- Confirm courier SLA and chain-of-custody steps (we're FBO red team validation).
- Share the signer rotation matrix and how operator key ceremonies are performed at site.
- Provide a 2-hour onsite validation checklist the field operator will run with us watching (remote screenshare).
- DocuSign/approval link for final acceptance so procurement can close the PO on our end.

Can you confirm timeline for the above and who will be our primary technical contact during acceptance? We are targeting week of 27 May for the handoff, but that can slip if needed.

Thanks,
James

James — thanks for the clear list. Looping Priyom (release/airgap lead) and Marissa (customer success / logistics) to take the work items. Below is our proposed split and next steps so we have an auditable trail.

Plan (short):
1) Logistics & courier SLA: Marissa will send the courier contract excerpt and proposed delivery window.
2) Signer rotation matrix & KMS handoff: Priyom will share the rotation csv and describe the offline key ceremony steps.
3) Operator validation checklist: I attached a short acceptance checklist (sealed-bundle-acceptance-checklist.pdf) we use as a template — we can tailor it to Ariadne's environment.
4) Formal sign-off: We'll generate a DocuSign packet for the acceptance criteria; procurement folks will use that.

Proposed owners and deadlines: 
- Marissa: courier SLA excerpt + proposed shipment date by 2024-05-17 EOD
- Priyom: signer rotation matrix + operator activation steps by 2024-05-16 12:00 PDT
- Logan: prepare DocuSign draft and acceptance criteria by 2024-05-20

We can also run a short dry-run video call (30m) to walk through the operator checklist on 21 or 22 May if that helps.

Thanks — we want to keep this tight so you have the artifacts you need for procurement.

— Logan Wright
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
logan_wright@redwood.ai

Attachment: sealed-bundle-acceptance-checklist.pdf (PDF, 1.2 MB)
From: priyom_das@redwood.ai
To: logan_wright@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: James O'Neil <j.oneil@ariadne-sys.com>
Date: Thu, 16 May 2024 09:38:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sealed bundle acceptance kickoff — Ariadne Systems

Folks — attaching the signer rotation matrix and a concise operator activation script. Quick summary here so Ariadne has visibility before we share the files:

Signer rotation matrix (attached: signer-rotation-matrix.csv) — columns: role, name, email, signing-credential-id, key-type, rotation-window-days, backup-operator. Key points:
- We use a threshold of two independent signers for release activation (primary + witness).
- Credentials are HSM-wrapped; on air-gapped installs we provide an offline signing token and a QR-encoded manifest for acceptance.
- Rotation cadence at standard customers is 90 days; for regulated sites (like Ariadne's) we recommend 45 days for the first cycle and then 90 days thereafter.

Operator activation steps (attached: operator-activation-steps.txt) — condensed checklist:
1) Verify package seal integrity (serial numbers + QR manifest).
2) Validate manifest hash against the signed envelope (we provide a small verification binary and offline docs).
3) Unpack to isolated host behind the operator console; do not connect to any external network.
4) Execute: checksum-verify.sh and start local healthcheck; capture logs to a USB stick for audit.
5) Operator calls into Redwood observer channel; we watch via screen-share and request ledger entries for signoff.

Courier notes (I captured SLA bullets below to help procurement):
- Standard sealed delivery window: 3 business days within continental US; express options available with 24-hour notice.
- Courier provides chain-of-custody manifest and tamper-evident bag; signature required on arrival.
- For red-team validation we can arrange double-signed chain-of-custody and timestamped photos on pickup/drop-off.

I'll attach the two files to this thread. If Ariadne prefers, we can tighten rotation cadence — happy to adjust.

Cheers,
Priyom Das
Release & Airgap Lead, Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.ai

Attachments: signer-rotation-matrix.csv (CSV, 3 KB); operator-activation-steps.txt (TXT, 4 KB)

Cc: priyom_das@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, engops@ariadne-sys.com
Date: Fri, 17 May 2024 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sealed bundle acceptance kickoff — Ariadne Systems

Thanks Logan / Priyom — this is helpful and thorough. A couple quick items before we lock dates: 

- Ariadne will run the onsite operator validation on 29 May (Thursday) at 13:00 PT — can Redwood commit to having an operator watch and confirm ledger entries at that time?
- For the signer rotation, we accept the 45-day initial cadence but request a written exception documenting that the witness signer can be remote for the first cycle (we'll need this for our compliance team).
- Please send the DocuSign packet mentioned and we'll get legal/procurement moving.

If you can confirm the courier SLA (Marissa) and drop the DocuSign link in this thread we can create the PO.

Best,
James
